answers.core: Adding this would naturally extend its utility without introducing breaking changes. While this could theoretically be implemented as an add-on, I don't see any reason not to simply add this method. Also this is my first proposal so I hope I did this correctly:)
answers.workaround: The functionality can technically be worked around with GDScript, but performance is significantly worse compared to a native C++ implementation. Given that BitMap is often used in performance-critical applications like collision detection or pathfinding, a GDScript solution is not practical for per-frame use cases.
